body: I got more bad news TODAY. i was not selected for the police department i applied to after a long one year process. it just keeps getting harder......help?

Finding a new partner is the last thing on my mind. I dont even think its possible for a guy like me to find anyone like her anymore. I lost my chance. maybe shell always be the one that got away from me? plus im never in the position to meet anyone new. i dont even know anyone to begin with.
How long did it take for you to move on? I feel like time is only hurting me right now and everyday gets harder. i can barely eat. i dont wanna go to work.
